research_question: Do fixed semantic events extracted from complete SEC 8-K submission text produce PIT-safe sector-relative drift that survives a later calendar year?
technical_corrections_before_performance: After 5,472 discovery submissions had been cached and before any performance was measured, a fetch-only operational flag was added so resumable batches do not repeatedly scan all cached text. Accessions, raw bytes, semantic regexes, labels, outcomes, splits, gates, and selection rules are unchanged.

The normal incomplete-batch path was also changed to defer classification and omit a labels path until planned coverage is complete. This is consistent with fetch-only operation and changes no research input or rule.

After discovery fetching completed and before classification or performance, a classify-only operational flag and explicit failure accounting were added. The frozen 30 MiB limit excludes 64 oversize submissions and one SEC 404 while preserving them in status provenance; no content, label, outcome, split, gate, or selection definition changed.

The sequential local classifier timed out before writing labels. A hash-locked parallel classifier was added before any label or performance output; it imports the exact frozen regex dictionary from the fetcher and changes only local execution.

The thread-pool classifier also timed out before writing labels because Python regex normalization remained GIL-bound. It was changed to a four-process pool with progress output before any label or performance output; regexes and all research definitions are unchanged.

The ordered process-pool run stalled before its first output and was terminated without labels. The classifier now supports independent frozen-year parts followed by a strict row-count combine; this changes only scheduling and creates no partial performance input.
relationship_to_prior_work: Prior SEC families used submission metadata items, Form 4 transactions, ownership roles, or broad form categories. This family uses fixed phrases in complete 8-K submission text and does not retest Item 2.02, deal, governance, 13D, or Form 4 definitions.

splits.discovery: 2018-01-01 through 2020-12-31 filings; all 18,892 frozen PIT-top500 accessions are fetched before performance.
splits.temporal_replication: Calendar-2021 filings; content is fetched and performance scored only for semantic-class/horizon cells passing discovery.
splits.later_data: No 2022-2026 filing content or performance may be consumed by this family.

buyback_authorization: authorized/approved/adopted within 180 characters of share/stock repurchase program/plan
repurchase program/plan within 180 characters of authorized/approved/adopted
going_concern_distress: substantial doubt and continue as a going concern within fixed windows
financial_restatement: financial statements/results should no longer be relied upon
non-reliance on previously issued financial statements
strategic_alternatives: review/explore/evaluate/consider strategic alternatives within fixed windows

fetch_contract.source: Polygon SEC index supplies accession and complete-submission URL; SEC Archives supplies raw text.
fetch_contract.universe: Form exactly 8-K, unique accession, filing date in stage, ticker in backward-assigned quarterly PIT market-cap top500 snapshot. Old/manual 62 is excluded.
fetch_contract.raw_preservation: Each complete submission is gzip-cached and never deleted or rewritten. Maximum accepted raw response is 30 MiB; oversize/error rows remain explicit failures.
fetch_contract.fair_access: Identified User-Agent, global request rate no more than 8 requests/second, retries and resumability.
fetch_contract.availability: Acceptance timestamp must be parsed from the SEC submission header. Missing timestamps are excluded from performance rather than replaced with filing date.

performance_contract.entry_assignment: Each accepted filing is assigned to the first full trading session whose 09:15 ET cutoff is strictly later than acceptance; entry is exact 09:35.
performance_contract.universe_and_controls: Event ticker must pass the daily PIT eligibility filter, price >=$5, ADV20 >=$10m, and quarterly PIT top500 membership. Residual return subtracts the same-session same-SIC median return among eligible PIT top500 names; if fewer than five sector controls exist, use the PIT-top500 median.
performance_contract.missing_prices: Selection occurs before outcome availability. Exact target close is preferred; otherwise use the last available close after entry and no later than target; no future price means a -100% underlying write-off before residualization.
performance_contract.statistics: For each of six semantic classes and three horizons, test the mean event residual return across unique issuer/session events. Discovery direction is the sign of the mean; no class has a preassigned long/short direction.
performance_contract.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across all 18 discovery cells at q <=0.10.

gates.coverage: At least 80 unique discovery issuer/session events, at least 15 in each of 2018, 2019, and 2020, and at least two of three annual means with the aggregate sign.
gates.discovery: Two-sided q <=0.10, absolute t >=2.0, and absolute residual mean >=0.15% d1, >=0.40% d5, or >=0.80% d20.
gates.replication: At least 20 events, same sign, directional t >=1.0, and absolute residual mean >=25% of discovery.
gates.production: Never granted by this diagnostic. Any replicated cell requires a separately preregistered full-refill compounding portfolio replay with transaction costs, dollar/percentage DD, concentration, and missing-price audit.

selection_effect: Rule selection is the frozen 18-cell semantic-class/horizon family. Trade selection is every causally available qualifying filing event; no ticker PnL removal, price-reaction threshold, semantic threshold tuning, class addition, or direction inversion is allowed after performance.
technical_correction_policy: Only a documented runtime/plumbing correction before the first performance output is allowed; semantic regexes, accessions, splits, outcomes, controls, gates, and multiple-testing policy may not change.
